$Comment: SummaryHud.Position is a shared-library HudPosition preset id, authored PascalCase like every other id in this schema (e.g. 'TopCenter'). Matching is case- and underscore-insensitive, so 'TOP_CENTER' resolves to the same preset. The Limits group is deliberately NOT authored here: every ceiling under it means unlimited when absent, and the right ceiling depends on a server's own player count and hardware, so shipping numbers would impose a guess on everyone. A busy server adds e.g. 'Limits': { 'MaxSessionsPerWorld': 60, 'MaxPuppetsPerWorld': 40, 'MaxStashesPerSection': 8 }; each knob is independent and any one may be set on its own. MaxStashesPerSection caps how many blocks in one 16x16x16 chunk section may hold placed station input; topping up material already placed is never denied. Limits.UnattendedIntervalMs paces each world's unattended pass (stations whose action authors Work.Unattended settling with nobody engaged, plus the placed-item display rebuild after a chunk loads) and defaults to 1000ms when absent; raise it to settle in coarser, cheaper bursts - the settled amounts come out the same either way.
